policies.description: Any request to create or update a record must validate that all required (mandatory) fields are present and non‑empty before invoking the tool.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.description: The system must not assume or fabricate any identifiers (e.g., caller_id, configuration_item) and must rely on verified data from previous lookups or API results before using them in the request.
references: Never assume or fabricate IDs, responses, or outcomes — rely solely on verified API results.

policies.description: When an identifier such as a user ID (caller_id) is not already known, a lookup must be performed to retrieve and verify the correct value before it is used in the create_new_incident_template call.
references: When identifiers such as names or IDs are missing, perform lookups, verify that you are reusing correct values from previous responses, and proceed using the retrieved data.

policies.description: Only a single validated operation (the creation of the incident template) may be performed at a time; no additional actions should be combined with this call.
references: Atomic Operations: Perform one validated operation at a time, except when using approved batch endpoints.
